Agent Name: MBTA_FranciscoFoxboroLine_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a factual error in Step 1 by providing an inaccurate list of stops for the MBTA Franklin-Foxboro line. Specifically, the agent included "Back Bay" as a stop on this line. In reality, the Franklin-Foxboro line (formerly the Franklin Branch) branches off the Red Line at Ruggles; it does not stop at Back Bay. Because this initial list was incorrect, the subsequent calculation of the number of stops between South Station and Windsor Gardens (which relied on the position of Back Bay and the total count) was flawed, leading to the wrong final answer of 12 instead of the correct 11.
